question: GQ-006
action: snapshot live gateway log to vault, verify, supersede the stale archive — never delete (C1)
snapshot_lag_note: One row behind live: the daemon wrote during .backup. Expected for a consistent point-in-time copy, not a defect.

superseded_archive.containment_proof: attach + select count(*) from old where id not in (select id from new) returned 0

retention_finding.conclusion: Age-based retention is NOT the fix. Only 0.02 of 4.88 GB is older than 24 hours — the volume is traffic from the last few hours. A 24h retention policy would free ~0.4% of the log while appearing to be a solution. The driver is body persistence per request, not accumulation over time.
